ns2:section.sectionText: Psychology of Advertising Description: This course is designed to familiarize students with theory and research at the intersection of advertising and psychology. It will explore issues such as: basic research methodology, the emergence of trends, attitudes and persuasion, human and brand personality, cross-cultural advertising, implicit consumer cognition, and coolness. Meets with ADV 590-R (CRN 56180)
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
